Language and appearance of this dashboard.
Thresholds and safety switches for the compression pipeline.
Reduce request size before routing while preserving code, errors, paths, numbers, and tool definitions.
Rewrites each request before it is sent to a provider so it uses fewer tokens. Code, errors, file paths and numbers are protected, and any rewrite that damages them is discarded.
Off sends requests untouched. Lossless only removes duplicated and wasted text. Standard also shortens tool output. Aggressive additionally condenses older turns.
Replaces a block of text that already appeared earlier in the conversation with a short reference to it.
Trims trailing spaces, collapses repeated blank lines and drops duplicated system messages.
Replaces an earlier file read with a note once the same file is read or edited again later.
Shortens command and tool output such as builds, tests and installs. Error and stack-trace lines always survive.
Re-encodes long JSON arrays that share the same fields as a compact table. Reversible, so nothing is lost.
Drops the sentences least related to the latest message once a message exceeds its size budget.
Condenses turns beyond the most recent few into a short summary that keeps paths, errors and decisions.
Removes the least valuable lines until the request fits the token target.
Requests estimated above this many tokens switch to Aggressive automatically. Leave empty to disable.
Leaves a system prompt untouched once the same text has been seen three times, so provider-side prompt caching keeps working.
Also loads tool-output filters from the working directory. Off by default, because a repository could use it to hide output from the model.

Off by default. Inside the window below, move 60% of the speed weight onto reliability — free relays are busiest then, so reliability predicts success better than raw throughput. Fastest and Most reliable are left alone.

Reliability leads (50%), with speed and intelligence weighted equally (25% each). A sensible all-round default.

Prefer the fastest model that still works. Speed 55%, reliability 35%, intelligence 10%.
Maximize success rate above all. Reliability 70%, speed and intelligence 15% each.
Set your own balance of reliability, speed and intelligence with sliders. Same engine as the presets, just your weights.
